faculty_override_note: The official two-year map is the planning default. DegreeWorks and Accounting faculty advisement remain authoritative.
sequence_notes: ACC 122 should be taken in the first semester and precedes later Accounting coursework.
MAT 206 may replace MAT 150; ECO 202 may replace ECO 201 but requires MAT 206 eligibility.
CIS 200 may replace CIS 100 after computer competency and an ACC or BUS course; the selector enforces the modeled ACC 122 course prerequisite, while competency testing remains an advising check.
Choose one Accounting elective from ACC 150, ACC 242, ACC 331, ACC 360, or ACC 370.
CED 301 requires permission from Internship and Experiential Learning.
A Writing Intensive course is required for graduation.
